optional_improvements: Label the small red dot that carries the rejection back to the producer (≈ 15.5–16.8 s) with 'rejected' so the response reads at phone size.
Use an amber producer border during 'got result' so a handled rejection is not read as a producer failure.
Note in the write-up that retries after rejection need back-off and a limit, and that RabbitMQ's default overflow drops oldest messages unless a reject policy is set.
